messages:
maya: Quick share — ran a compact burstbench across us-west, eu-central, asia-southeast comparing A100 vs H100 for (Llama2-7B / Mistral-7B) under q8x4 and fp16. Results attached: s3://redwood-perf/bench/1765432100/summary.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
igor: Nice. what was the workload mix? prefill heavy or decode-heavy?
maya: 70% decode-heavy (avg resp ~120 tokens), 30% long-prefill (prompt ~1024 tokens). We wanted a realistic RLHF-ish tail.
sam: any kernel fallbacks? local runtime chose fused-causal for H100, fallthrough to generic on A100 for Mistral q8x4. saw a couple of kernel warnings.
maya: yes, noted kernel fallthroughs on A100 for Mistral q8x4 at seq_len 1024. H100 stayed on optimized slicekernel.
liz: numbers? tokens/sec and $/1M?
maya: pasted quick table from CSV: H100 (Mistral q8x4): 12.8k tok/s decode, prefill p99 latency 340ms, $/1M tokens = $42. A100 (Mistral q8x4): 8.6k tok/s decode, prefill p99 520ms, $/1M = $62. For Llama2-7B q8x4 H100: 11.2k tok/s, $/1M = $46. A100 Llama2-7B q8x4: 7.9k tok/s, $/1M = $68.
igor: delta looks big. did you use same batch sizing / sustained qps?
maya: iso-sustained mode: 200 qps for decode (continuous), burst to 1k qps for 30s windows. batch config: target_batch_tokens=4096, max_lat_slo=250ms for interactive routes.
sam: when you say $/1M tokens can you share costing assumptions? GPU instance + amortized infra per-hour.
maya: cost model: A100 spot price $2.6/hr, H100 spot $4.2/hr (US-West), plus infra overhead $0.4/hr. token accounting uses actual tokens consumed incl. prefill. I attached the calc sheet.
perf-bot: perf-bot ran microtrace at 1765432200 — kernel selection: H100 -> slicekernel v2.1, A100 -> fallback generic_causal v1.4 for >512 seq_len.
igor: were KV cache sizes affected by quant? q8x4 cache memory hit?
maya: q8x4 reduces KV memory so H100 could keep larger batch windows without OOM; A100 hit soft OOM at 1k burst and started dropping to single-stream decode in 2 runs.
liz: any quality regressions observed for q8x4? prompt evals / rouge-ish checks?
maya: ran 500 eval prompts — chrF/ROUGE deltas < 0.7% on average, but a small subset (5%) had shorter completions on q8x4 for Mistral — flagged in evals. linked: https://s3.console.aws/..../evals/1765432100/report.html
sam: suggestion: try int8/4 fallback with KV caching enabled and increase target_batch_tokens to 8192 on A100 to squeeze more throughput; but watch latency SLO.
maya: will run another pass with that tomorrow, focusing on A100 kernel hints and forcing fused-causal when possible.
igor: also log config: `--kernels=prefer_fused --max-seq=1024 --batch-tokens=4096` for next run.
maya: thanks — scheduling next run 1765518500; will post CSV and short notes. :thumbsup:
